thread:
Tara: quick question about streaming deltas when a function/tool is invoked — do we stream role:\"tool\" chunks with a `name` field for each delta, or do we stream only content deltas and then emit a separate `function_call`/`tool_call` object at the end?

Jordan: my vote: stream incremental tool responses as role=\"tool\" with name set, so clients can render progressively. then send a final finish_reason/complete function_call object if needed.

Sam: curious about backward compatibility — older SDKs expect a single final function_call object (no intermittent tool role deltas). If we do both, how do we avoid confusing them?

Liam: we could keep both but make the streaming deltas opt-in via a param (e.g., `stream_tool_deltas=true`) so older clients keep current behavior. adding a flag avoids surprise.

Maria: what about the case where the model decides to both call a function and emit intermediate logs? example: tool emits JSON chunks + progress messages. streaming role=\"tool\" covers that.

Tara: example payloads for clarity:
```json
// delta 1
{"delta": {"role": "tool", "name": "code_executor", "content": "compiling... 10%"}}
// delta 2
{"delta": {"role": "tool", "name": "code_executor", "content": "compiling... 45%"}}
// final event
{"function_call": {"name": "code_executor", "arguments": "{...}"}, "finish_reason": "function_call"}
```

Jordan: that looks fine. clients that don't understand tool-role deltas can ignore them and still rely on the final `function_call` event. key is we must document that final event always appears.

Sam: ok, but SDKs that validate schema on the fly may reject intermediate messages that include `function_call`-adjacent fields. we should keep delta schema minimal: only role/name/content until final. avoid nesting `function_call` object until finish.

Liam: agree. also add a small note about streaming `finish_reason`: use \"function_call\" for a function-driven finish, \"stop\" for normal ends, etc. make sure transitions are explicit.

Maria: small ping — do we need a new media-type or header? or just document the param and update console + changelog?

Tara: plan proposal: 1) default behavior unchanged (final function_call only) 2) add `stream_tool_deltas` query param for hosted API + similar flag in private config 3) when enabled, stream role=\"tool\" deltas with `name` and `content` only 4) final event contains full `function_call` object + finish_reason 5) SDKs add opt-in handler for tool-delta events

Jordan: sounds good. can we also add an explicit `delta_type` field for future extensibility? maybe overkill now — we can rely on role/name.

Sam: please add a short example to the OpenAPI spec and include a migration note for SDKs. I'll follow up with a checklist for QA.

api-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://internal/repo/PR/542 — includes spec diff + example stream traces.

Tara: thanks — I'll draft the spec change and open a PR. target: add to next minor (backwards-compatible) release. @Sam @Jordan can you review the spec when I post? :thumbsup:

Sam: yep, will review.

Jordan: counting me in. :eyes:

Liam: I'll add unit tests for the server-side emitter and a flag gate.

Maria: and I'll update the docs/console blurb and the changelog entry.

Tara: awesome, thanks team. moving this to async. will post PR link here when ready.
